description_html:
The Uwell Caliburn GPP Replacement Pod is a refillable replacement pod for compatible Uwell devices.

  • Product Type: Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Built-in Coil)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 3mL
  • Coil Resistance: 0.4Ω / 0.6Ω / 0.9Ω / 1.2Ω (built-in, varies by pod)
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: Uwell Caliburn G3, G4 and G5 series (including GK3)
  • Pack Contents: 4 Pods
  • Brand: Uwell

Coil is built in - replace the pod when flavour fades. E-liquid sold separately.

Available options: 0.4 ohm (3mL), 0.6 ohm (3mL), 0.9 ohm (3mL), 1.2 ohm (3mL).
